objective: Build a detailed raw GRWL GeoParquet/PMTiles release and audit other prepared products for omitted source detail or overstated validation.
geometry_contract: Preserve raw record multiplicity, source tile, original record ordinal, multipart boundaries and all XY float64 values. No connecting records by segmentID or segmentInd.
Preserve all ten original DBF numeric values including original width_m sentinel1; expose width validity separately.
Use deterministic JSON-safe numeric feature IDs from tile identity plus original record ordinal; segmentID is not globally unique.
Analytical GeoParquet is lossless; display is explicitly generalized. Dateline splitting is display-only.

No fabricated edges crossing gaps; compare actual PMTiles to raw sources. At maxzoom require complete source-ID accounting including enumerated quantization collapses; never silently drop unexpected IDs.

validation.source_comparison: All pilot source records and attributes, exact source geometry; global streaming source-row and per-tile equality checks for every acquired tile.
validation.pilot_sample_rule: Each pilot tile: first32 original records plus up to32 longest source pieces, selected before display results; known error locations compare decoded raw coverage to raw source.
validation.global_sample_rule: Per tile first8 original nonempty records plus longest8; explicitly test dateline crossing records wherever present.
fixtures: two separated pieces sharing segmentID must stay separate
width_m1 unknown and true width values
both dateline directions and tiny boundary fragments
stable IDs and sentinel-preserving analytical fields
validation.browser: Local range serving, inspect actual width fields and exact source lookup; inspect known problem regions; no public hosting claim.

rubric: Exact scientific product, version and scope versus complete authoritative release
Any lower-detail source selected when richer matching data exist
Omitted layers, rows, fields, precision, time spans or geography
What actual validation ran and what remains untested
Known failures and whether final claims disclose them
audit.not_implied: Rebuilding the producer scientific model from original observations is outside a format-conversion mirror; authoritative derived science products are not automatically shortcuts.

exclusions: No remote data upload, registry submission, push or messages to producers
No overwrite of immutable summary release

resource_revision_basis.uncertainty: Linear extrapolation from nine North American tiles; not a guaranteed size or runtime. Native sort and finalization scratch require additional headroom.
resource_revision_basis.reason: User freed disk space for the global conversion. Increase only the task storage allowance after the measured pilot; scientific/geometry acceptance thresholds, two-thread limit, 40GiB start and15GiB stop floors remain identical.
